" Welcome to the Complete SQL Course! Whether you're a beginner starting your journey or looking to advance your skills, this course has everything you need to master SQL. Learn how to work with databases, write powerful queries, and handle real-world data problems.
What you’ll learn:
SQL Basics: Tables, Columns, and Queries
Data Manipulation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Filtering and Sorting Data with WHERE and ORDER BY
Joins: INNER, OUTER, SELF, CROSS
Aggregate Functions and GROUP BY
Subqueries and Set Operators
